text:
Cole Caufield is making history in overtime. Heavy.com ran the headline "Canadiens' Caufield is Doing Something the NHL has Never Seen Before", and a Montreal Hockey Fanatics headline had goalie Jakub Dobes calling it "ridiculous". The numbers back up the noise: 11 goals in 17 games, and he ranks 9th of 506 skaters in wins added by his goals.

This is the player who scored 51 goals last season and won the Lady Byng. He gets to the slot, 97th percentile in chances from the home-plate area in Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking, and his own chances this season are strong.

But his finishing is running hot even for him. He has 11 goals on 7.5 expected, shooting 19%, and the Canadiens have scored 4.9 more goals than expected with him on the ice. At five on five, Montreal is roughly even in expected goals with him out there. His minutes have also dipped about two a night lately. We'd expect fewer overtime miracles and a slower goal pace, though still a lot of goals.
headline: Caufield keeps winning games, and it may not last
